1. **P0 - Text Overflow in Takeaway Box**: The text in the takeaway box is slightly truncated on the right side. The text element has `x="640"` and `text-anchor="middle"`, but its content is too long for the `width="1200"` of the containing rectangle, causing it to overflow. 
   **Fix**: Reduce the font size of the takeaway text from `font-size="18"` to `font-size="16"` to ensure it fits within the allocated width. Alternatively, increase the width of the takeaway box or reduce the text content. 
2. **P1 - Insufficient Vertical Spacing in Cards**: The body text within each card is too close to the card title. The `dy="30"` for the second line of text is also a bit tight for `font-size="22"`. 
   **Fix**: For all four cards, increase the vertical spacing between the card title and the body text. For example, for Card 1, change the body text's `y` attribute from `y="295"` to `y="305"` (or similar adjustment for other cards). Also, consider increasing the `dy` value for the `tspan` elements from `dy="30"` to `dy="35"` for better line spacing.
